findings.message: 1 frame reaches back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x1B1B has a main_data_begin of 485 bytes where at most 209 are allowed. Encoders such as LAME exceed it, and decoders accept it.
